what_happened: The job was meant to track operator mistakes as their own intervention category. It was rejected: "fail: 1 of 6 criteria unmet; 1 blocker or major finding". The unmet criterion is the `cargo test` one. It requires a test with several mistake interventions of different classes and causes. That test must show status and the audit output report mistake counts per class and per cause, and that the JSON carries those breakdowns separately from `interventions_by_category`. The one major finding says criterion 2 needs such a test and none exists (crates/athena-cli/tests/, auditor.rs / introspection.rs). No failed checks are listed. The other 5 criteria were met, so the feature may work. The behavior was not demonstrated by a test.
cause: Nothing requires the producer to map each criterion to a named test or recorded evidence before handover. A criterion that demands a specific test, here one with mixed classes and causes covering both status and audit output and the JSON shape, is checked only by the verifier at the final verdict, where rejection is the only outcome. Earlier jobs were rejected for the same missing evidence and no pre-handover check followed. This is an inference, since the stored fields do not show what the producer ran or wrote.
prevention: Add a pre-handover check that blocks the producer from finishing until every acceptance criterion has a recorded evidence entry. For criteria that name a test, the entry must point to a test that exists in the diff and passed in a recorded run. A criterion with no mapped test or command output sends the job back to the producer for another round, not on to the verifier.
proposed_request: Add a pre-handover evidence check to the job pipeline. Before a job moves from the producer to the verifier, require each acceptance criterion to have an evidence entry. When a criterion calls for a test, the entry must name a test added or changed in the diff and cite a recorded run in which it passed. If any criterion lacks evidence, return the job to the producer with the list of uncovered criteria, within the existing round limit, instead of sending it to the verifier. Acceptance: a test where a job has an uncovered criterion is returned to the producer and does not reach the verifier; a test where all criteria have evidence proceeds to the verifier; cargo test, clippy and fmt pass. Then re-run the operator-mistakes job (20261023-183334-aej6) with the added test of per-class and per-cause mistake counts in status, the audit output and the JSON, kept separate from interventions_by_category.
